description.name: ConnectReseller
description.tagline: Community-maintained ConnectReseller registrar for WHMCS 8.x and 9.x
description.long: Drop-in fork of ConnectReseller WHMCS registrar 2.5.1 with PHP 7.4–8.3 support, security fixes, and a TLD price-sync addon. Keep the module directory name connectreseller so existing tblregistrars rows continue to work.
